tools.name: fub_get_identity
tools.description: Who the credential belongs to: the account (id, domain, owner) and the authenticated user. A cheap way to confirm the API key works. FUB: GET /v1/identity.

tools.name: fub_search_people
tools.description: Search contacts and leads. Criteria combine with AND. Tips: new leads nobody worked = contacted false + createdAfter; gone-quiet leads = lastActivityBefore + stage; a Smart List = smartListId. Name filters are partial matches. Newest first by default. People in the Trash stage are excluded unless in

tools.name: fub_get_person
tools.description: Fetch one contact by id. Pass fields="allFields" to include custom fields and everything else. FUB: GET /v1/people/{id}.

tools.name: fub_check_duplicate_person
tools.description: Check if a contact with this email or phone already exists anywhere in the account (even ones this user cannot see) and who it is assigned to. Use before adding a lead. FUB: GET /v1/people/checkDuplicate.

tools.name: fub_list_events
tools.description: Lead activity: registrations, inquiries, viewed/saved properties, website visits, etc. Filter by person or type. Some events are only visible in the FUB app. FUB: GET /v1/events.

tools.name: fub_list_calls
tools.description: Logged phone calls with outcome, direction and duration. Filter by person or number. FUB: GET /v1/calls.

tools.name: fub_list_text_messages
tools.description: Text messages for a person or a phone number. This tool needs personId, toNumber or fromNumber (find the person with fub_search_people first). Message bodies may be hidden by FUB for privacy. FUB: GET /v1/textMessages.

tools.name: fub_list_tasks
tools.description: Tasks (follow-ups, calls, showings…). Filter by person, assignee, type, completion, or due window (due="today"|"overdue"|"upcoming"). FUB: GET /v1/tasks.

tools.name: fub_list_appointments
tools.description: Calendar appointments with invitees, type and outcome. Filter by person, user, or a start+end window (both required together). FUB: GET /v1/appointments.

tools.name: fub_list_deals
tools.description: Deals (transactions) with stage, price, people, agents and commission. Filter by pipeline, user, person or status. The response metadata includes totalByStageId. FUB: GET /v1/deals.

tools.name: fub_list_pipelines
tools.description: Deal pipelines with their stages (the stage ids that fub_create_deal / fub_update_deal take). FUB: GET /v1/pipelines.

tools.name: fub_list_stages
tools.description: Contact lifecycle stages (Lead, Nurture, Past Client, Trash…) with people counts — the names fub_search_people and fub_update_person take as "stage". FUB: GET /v1/stages.

tools.name: fub_list_users
tools.description: Users in the account (agents, brokers, lenders) — the ids to assign people, tasks and deals to. FUB: GET /v1/users.

tools.name: fub_list_custom_fields
tools.description: The account's contact custom fields: label, API name (customXxx), type and dropdown choices. Use the name as a key in customFields. FUB: GET /v1/customFields.

tools.name: fub_list_action_plans
tools.description: The account's action plans (drip campaigns): id, name and status. Gives the names for the actionPlanId values of fub_list_person_action_plans. FUB: GET /v1/actionPlans.

tools.name: fub_list_person_action_plans
tools.description: Which people are on which action plan, with the status of each assignment (e.g. "Running", "Paused"). Give personId for one contact's plans, or actionPlanId for everyone on one plan. For many contacts, list each active plan's people (limit 100; page with offset until _metadata.total is covered) inst

tools.name: fub_lead_source_report
tools.description: Count leads from lead sources (e.g. Zillow) per assigned agent, how many reached the closed stage(s) (conversion rate), and leads per lender user (e.g. Zillow Home Loans loan officers). Use it to count instead of paging through fub_search_people. The numbers approximate FUB's in-app Lead Source repo

tools.name: fub_send_lead_event
tools.description: Add a new lead or record activity on an existing one — FUB's documented way to create leads. FUB de-duplicates by email/phone (or use person.id to target a contact), routes the lead per Lead Flow, notifies the agent and runs action plans for Registration / Inquiry types. A 204 means the lead flow fo

tools.name: fub_update_person
tools.description: Update a contact's fields. CAUTION: `tags` REPLACES all tags unless mergeTags is true; `phones` and `emails` REPLACE the full list (send existing ones too). Setting contacted=true pauses action plans. source/sourceUrl cannot be changed after creation. FUB: PUT /v1/people/{id}.

tools.name: fub_add_note
tools.description: Add a note to a contact's timeline. FUB: POST /v1/notes.

tools.name: fub_log_call
tools.description: Record a phone call made or received outside FUB, with its outcome. Does not place a call. FUB: POST /v1/calls.

tools.name: fub_create_task
tools.description: Create a task on a contact, assigned to a user (assignedUserId or assignedTo is required). FUB: POST /v1/tasks.

tools.name: fub_update_task
tools.description: Update a task — mark it complete, reopen, rename, retype or reassign it. Rescheduling: FUB documents dueDate/dueDateTime only on task create, so the tool sends them and checks the reply; if FUB did not take the new date, the result has a warning. FUB: PUT /v1/tasks/{id}.

tools.name: fub_create_deal
tools.description: Create a deal in a pipeline stage (stage ids from fub_list_pipelines). Include userIds — a deal with no users is invisible to agents. FUB: POST /v1/deals.

tools.name: fub_update_deal
tools.description: Update a deal — move it to another stage, change price, dates, people or agents. peopleIds/userIds replace the full list. FUB: PUT /v1/deals/{id}.

tools.name: fub_get_note
tools.description: Read one note by id, optionally with its threaded replies and reactions. Notes that came from email or restricted systems answer 404 for privacy. FUB: GET /v1/notes/{id}.

tools.name: fub_get_task
tools.description: Read one task by id. FUB: GET /v1/tasks/{id}.

tools.name: fub_get_deal
tools.description: Read one deal by id with its people, users, stage and custom fields. FUB: GET /v1/deals/{id}.

tools.name: fub_get_appointment
tools.description: Read one appointment by id with its invitees, type and outcome. FUB: GET /v1/appointments/{id}.

tools.name: fub_list_appointment_types
tools.description: Appointment types (Showing, Listing appointment ...) with the ids fub_create_appointment takes as typeId. FUB: GET /v1/appointmentTypes.

tools.name: fub_list_appointment_outcomes
tools.description: Appointment outcomes (Met, No show ...) with the ids fub_update_appointment takes as outcomeId. FUB: GET /v1/appointmentOutcomes.

tools.name: fub_list_smart_lists
tools.description: The account's Smart Lists with ids. To read the people in one, call fub_search_people with smartListId. FUB: GET /v1/smartLists.

tools.name: fub_get_smart_list
tools.description: One Smart List's details (id and name). FUB: GET /v1/smartLists/{id}.

tools.name: fub_list_ponds
tools.description: Lead ponds: name, pond lead agent (userId) and members (userIds). People in a pond have fub_search_people assignedPondId. FUB: GET /v1/ponds.

tools.name: fub_list_teams
tools.description: Teams with their leaders and members (empty on plans without teams; team 1 is the whole company). FUB: GET /v1/teams.

tools.name: fub_list_groups
tools.description: Agent and lender groups used for lead routing (round robin, first to claim). FUB: GET /v1/groups.

tools.name: fub_list_timeframes
tools.description: Buying/selling timeframes (0-3 months ...) with the ids fub_update_person takes as timeframeId. FUB: GET /v1/timeframes.

tools.name: fub_list_deal_custom_fields
tools.description: Deal custom fields: label, API name, type and choices. FUB: GET /v1/dealCustomFields.

tools.name: fub_list_email_templates
tools.description: Email templates with subject and body (merge fields like %contact_name%). FUB: GET /v1/templates.

tools.name: fub_list_text_templates
tools.description: Text message templates with their text. FUB: GET /v1/textMessageTemplates.

tools.name: fub_merge_email_template
tools.description: Fill an email template's merge fields for one contact and get the final subject and body to review or copy. Nothing is sent and nothing changes. FUB: POST /v1/templates/merge.

tools.name: fub_merge_text_template
tools.description: Fill a text message template's merge fields for one contact and get the final text to review or copy. Nothing is sent and nothing changes. FUB: POST /v1/textMessageTemplates/merge.

tools.name: fub_list_relationships
tools.description: A contact's relationships (spouse, co-buyer ...) with their emails and phones. FUB: GET /v1/peopleRelationships.

tools.name: fub_list_unclaimed_leads
tools.description: New leads offered to this user through First to Claim that nobody claimed yet. Offers pass to a fallback agent after a short time (default 15 minutes), so the list is often empty. Claim one with fub_claim_lead. FUB: GET /v1/people/unclaimed.

tools.name: fub_daily_brief
tools.description: One user's day in one call: today's appointments, tasks due today, overdue tasks, and new leads nobody has contacted yet. Default: the API key's own user, today in timeZone. FUB: GET /v1/appointments, /v1/tasks, /v1/people.

tools.name: fub_team_follow_up_report
tools.description: Per agent: overdue tasks, tasks due today, new leads and new leads not yet contacted, sorted by most work waiting. Use it to see who needs help or which leads wait. At most 100 FUB requests (4 per agent). FUB: GET /v1/tasks and /v1/people totals.

tools.name: fub_create_person
tools.description: Add a contact by hand, e.g. a past client or a sphere contact. This does NOT run lead routing, notifications or action plans: for a new lead from a website, portal or open house use fub_send_lead_event instead. deduplicate (default true) returns the existing contact when the email or phone matches.

tools.name: fub_claim_lead
tools.description: Claim a First to Claim lead from fub_list_unclaimed_leads for this user. A 409 means someone else claimed it first. FUB: POST /v1/people/claim.

tools.name: fub_create_appointment
tools.description: Book an appointment, e.g. a showing or listing appointment, with contacts and/or agents as invitees. Invitations are sent only with sendInvitation true. FUB: POST /v1/appointments.

tools.name: fub_update_appointment
tools.description: Move, rename or change an appointment, or record its outcome (outcomeId). Fields you leave out keep their value. FUB: PUT /v1/appointments/{id}.

tools.name: fub_delete_appointment
tools.description: Cancel and delete an appointment. This cannot be undone. FUB: DELETE /v1/appointments/{id}.

tools.name: fub_update_note
tools.description: Change a note's subject or text. FUB: PUT /v1/notes/{id}.

tools.name: fub_delete_note
tools.description: Delete a note. It cannot be recovered. FUB: DELETE /v1/notes/{id}.

tools.name: fub_delete_task
tools.description: Delete a task. It cannot be recovered; to finish a task use fub_update_task isCompleted instead. FUB: DELETE /v1/tasks/{id}.

tools.name: fub_delete_deal
tools.description: Delete a deal: it leaves the deal lists (status Deleted; fub_list_deals includeDeleted still shows it). Agents can delete only their own deals. FUB: DELETE /v1/deals/{id}.

tools.name: fub_create_relationship
tools.description: Add a related person (spouse, co-buyer ...) to a contact. FUB: POST /v1/peopleRelationships.

tools.name: fub_update_relationship
tools.description: Change a relationship's name, type, emails, phones or addresses. A non-empty array REPLACES the existing list; FUB cannot clear a list. FUB: PUT /v1/peopleRelationships/{id}.

tools.name: fub_apply_action_plan
tools.description: Put a contact on a classic action plan (drip). Plan ids: fub_list_action_plans. FUB: POST /v1/actionPlansPeople.

tools.name: fub_set_action_plan_status
tools.description: Pause or resume one contact's action plan, e.g. when they ask you to hold off. The id is the assignment id from fub_list_person_action_plans (not the plan id). Steps already sent cannot be recalled. FUB: PUT /v1/actionPlansPeople/{id}.

tools.name: fub_bulk_update_people
tools.description: Make one change to up to 100 contacts: set stage, assigned agent, pond or contacted, and add or remove tags. Each contact is a separate update; the result lists failures and contacts not attempted. Reassigning can notify agents. FUB: PUT /v1/people/{id} per contact.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: fub_check_duplicate_person, fub_list_text_messages, fub_update_person, fub_get_note, fub_list_email_templates, fub_list_text_templates, fub_merge_email_template, fub_merge_text_template, fub_list_relationships, fub_create_person, fub_update_relationship · Private data: fub_get_identity, fub_search_people, fub_get_person, fub_check_duplicate_person, fub_list_stages, fub_list_custom_fields, fub_list_person_action_plans, fub_lead_source_report, fub_send_lead_event, fub_update_person, fub_add_note, fub_log_call, fub_create_task, fub_update_task, fub_merge_email_template, fub_merge_text_template, fub_list_relationships, fub_daily_brief, fub_create_person, fub_create_appointment, fub_update_appointment, fub_create_relationship, fub_apply_action_plan, fub_set_action_plan_status, fub_bulk_update_people · Public sink: fub_check_duplicate_person, fub_send_lead_event, fub_update_person, fub_add_note, fub_log_call, fub_create_task, fub_create_deal, fub_get_note, fub_list_email_templates, fub_merge_email_template, fub_merge_text_template, fub_create_person, fub_claim_lead, fub_create_appointment, fub_create_relationship, fub_apply_action_plan, fub_bulk_update_people · Destructive: fub_create_person, fub_delete_appointment, fub_delete_note, fub_delete_task, fub_delete_deal, fub_bulk_update_people.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
